description: Measured integration source profiles from bundled development fixtures. Fingerprints identify deployed files, never version folder presence. Vendor license code is read for fingerprinting only.

profiles.delivery: Unmodified version-pinned controller downloads used by Arix installer after payload overlay

baselineWarnings.message: The unchanged Arix v2.1.3 installer-delivery preset controller contains dynamic private-property initializers that fail PHP 8.2+ syntax. Obtain a corrected vendor delivery before using the Arix preset endpoint. The manager verifies exact baseline hashes and checks every changed or new PHP file plus isolated Panel boot; unrelated addon operations remain available.
